primary_bekar_status.reason: openICPSR exposes the file metadata publicly but requires an authenticated account before downloading. Direct HTTP requests are Cloudflare-challenged; the authenticated browser flow stops at the ICPSR sign-in page. No account was created and no credentials were supplied.

equivalent_direct_source.title: Sustainable Agriculture in the Middle Ages: The English Manor
equivalent_direct_source.creator: Jules N. Pretty
equivalent_direct_source.citation: Pretty, Jules N. (1990), Agricultural History Review 38(1), 1-19, Table 2

parsed_table.historical_unit: gross yield in kg per hectare on the standard acre
parsed_table.parser_contract: fitz_or_pypdf_extraction_then_strict_table_token_parse; OCR glyph corrections only; no missing-value or seed-rate imputation

eu5_mapping.mapping_method: named historical manors mapped to containing EU5 province selectors
eu5_mapping.coverage_warning: The downloaded article gives no defensible manor polygons. One named manor (Taunton) has a stable EU5 location tag; the remaining thirteen are province-only. Province-level comparison is valid as a broad containing-boundary diagnostic only; no province-wide population or yield label is inferred.

model_use.reason_direct_bias_invalid: The table is a realized long-run demesne mean over fourteen manors, while GAEZ/PyAEZ labels are conditional attainable potentials over broader EU5 footprints. It is a strict absolute-yield plausibility and one-sided attainable-to-realized diagnostic, not a location-level target.

related_equivalent_archive.title: Medieval Crop Yields Database
related_equivalent_archive.archive_role: independent direct-download provenance for the BAHS yield-per-seed workbooks; not substituted for Pretty's absolute kg/ha table

status.remaining_limitation: A direct model-bias score still requires an exact historical footprint and a conditional attainable-vs-realized comparison. This artifact closes source acquisition, unit verification, and reproducible absolute-yield validation; it does not pretend the broad province crosswalk supplies that missing footprint.
